description: This Go source file defines functions and types for converting diffs of board/card objects into Slack attachments, including templates for notifications about card changes (add, modify, delete). It handles template caching, rendering, and assembling Slack message fields based on diff data.

classes.name: DiffConvOpts
classes.description: Options for converting diffs to Slack attachments, including language, link generators, and logger.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns a cached or new text template based on name and language, parsing the default string if needed.

methods.name: makeAuthorsList
methods.description: Creates a comma-separated list of authors' names prefixed with '@'.

methods.name: execTemplate
methods.description: Executes a named template with provided data and writes output to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Diffs2SlackAttachments
methods.description: Converts a slice of Diff objects into Slack attachments for posting.

methods.name: cardDiff2SlackAttachment
methods.description: Creates a Slack attachment from a card diff, including change notifications and property updates.

methods.name: appendTitleChanges
methods.description: Adds title change info to Slack attachment fields if the title has changed.

methods.name: appendPropertyChanges
methods.description: Adds property diff info to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendCommentChanges
methods.description: Adds comment addition or deletion info to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendAttachmentChanges
methods.description: Adds attachment add/delete info to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendContentChanges
methods.description: Adds content/description change info to Slack attachment fields, including markdown diff.
